name: Gradient Scaling
aliases: Gradient Scaling — Sampling density based gradient scaling, Transmittance-based gradient scaling
definition: Techniques to alleviate near-camera overfitting and floaters by compensating for gradient imbalance caused by sampling density and transmittance attenuation.
summary: Gradient Scaling mitigates near-camera overfitting by rescaling gradients during backpropagation to ensure uniform magnitude across all ray samples, unlike distortion loss which modifies the loss function.
